sentences.text:
Sk. Abdul Jamir vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 2
August, 2021
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Blapl No.4624 of 2021

Sk. Abdul Jamir .... Petitioner
 Mr. B. S. Rayaguru, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....
Opposite Party
Mrs. S. Patnaik, Aga for State
Coram:

The Chief Justice
 Order

This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the Petitioner in connection with G.R. Case No.2871 of 2020, arising out of Jagatpur P.S. Case No.527 of 2020, for the offences under Sections 420/272/273/34 IPC r/w Sections 51/53/54/57/59/61/63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Section 32 of the Legal Metrology Act, 2011, pending in the court of learned J. M. F.C. (R), Cuttack.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3. An additional affidavit has been filed by the sister of the present Petitioner stating that his father has expired on 24th July, 2021.
4.

Mrs. Patnaik, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State has confirmed this fact and also filed the report dated 2nd August, 2021 of the I.I.C., Jagatpur Police Station, Cuttack, which is taken on record.
5. The charge sheet has been filed.
It is seen that the Petitioner was an employee of the principal accused and has been in custody since 17th December, 2020.
He has no criminal antecedents.
The co-accused is still in custody.
6. In the circumstances, the Court directs that the Petitioner be enlarged on bail subject to the conditions to be imposed by and to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
7. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
